name: Servo MIDI Music
summary: Generic USB-MIDI servo controller with pluck, on/off and impulse behaviours using PCA9685 expansion.
description: A configurable predecessor to the modern generic-control direction: multiple PCA9685 boards can scale the number of servo-controlled notes, with per-servo calibration and three action modes.

notes: USB MIDI and Arduino IDE are documented, but the README excerpt does not state a final board model.

mechanics.summary: Each MIDI note maps to a servo. Behaviour can be configured as alternating pluck, sustained on/off movement or timed impulse.
notes: Calibration helper lets each servo zero position be determined from the Arduino serial console.

actuators.notes: Can scale across multiple PCA9685 boards.

warnings: Repository states that the project is completed in code but has not yet been hardware-tested.
